data: Which of the following datasets have normalized sufficiency values that are greater than 0.4 for C=10?

The question asks which datasets have normalized sufficiency values greater than 0.4 when C = 10. From the caption, we can see that the second graph (b) represents the normalized sufficiency values. 

Looking at the graph, we need to identify the datasets whose lines exceed the value of 0.4 on the y-axis at C = 10. The datasets represented by the lines are WikiAttack, SS1, Movie, MultiMC, FEVER, and E-SNLI. 

By visually inspecting the graph, we can determine that the datasets WikiAttack, SS1, and Movie have their lines above the 0.4 mark at C = 10. Therefore, the datasets with normalized sufficiency values greater than 0.4 for C = 10 are WikiAttack, SS1, and Movie.
